crossRefs.note: God’s sons saw that men’s daughters were beautiful, and they took any that they wanted for themselves as wives.
“I made a covenant with my eyes, how then should I look lustfully at a young woman?
Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.
“Oholah played the prostitute when she was mine. She doted on her lovers, on the Assyrians her neighbors,
who were clothed with blue, governors and rulers, all of them desirable young men, horsemen riding on horses.
She lusted after the Assyrians, governors and rulers, her neighbors, clothed most gorgeously, horsemen riding on…
but I tell you that everyone who gazes at a woman to lust after her has committed adultery with her already in his…
having eyes full of adultery, and who can’t cease from sin; enticing unsettled souls; having a heart trained in greed…
For all that is in the world, the lust of the flesh, the lust of the eyes, and the pride of life, isn’t the Father’s…
When she had brought them near to him to eat, he took hold of her, and said to her, “Come, lie with me, my sister!”
to deliver you from the strange woman, even from the foreigner who flatters with her words,
lest you give your honor to others, and your years to the cruel one;
So she caught him, and kissed him. With an impudent face she said to him:
Therefore the showers have been withheld and there has been no latter rain; yet you have had a prostitute’s forehead…
You have built your lofty place at the head of every way, and have made your beauty an abomination, and have opened…
“ ‘ “A wife who commits adultery! Who takes strangers instead of her husband!
You are different from other women in your prostitution, in that no one follows you to play the prostitute; and whereas…

people.name: Joseph
people.line: Son of Jacob, ruler in Egypt

translations.web: After these things, his master’s wife set her eyes on Joseph; and she said, “Lie with me.”
translations.bsb: and after some time his master’s wife cast her eyes upon Joseph and said, “Sleep with me.”
translations.kjv: And it came to pass after these things, that his master's wife cast her eyes upon Joseph; and she said, Lie
translations.asv: And it came to pass after these things, that his master's wife cast her eyes upon Joseph; and she said, Lie with me.
